arguments.content:
# Candidate: raw-value histogram binning

Issue: /code/upstream-issues/langfuse-15208.md (enterprise_452a1a7f3eb80e14cfc4d7a0)

Correctness contract: compute min, range, and bucket placement from raw numeric scores. Round only generated display labels, selecting precision from bin width so adjacent edges remain distinct. Regression: 0.857 with seven bins over [0, 1] belongs in bin index 5, while 1 remains in the final bin.

Changed code: /code/langfuse/web/src/features/dashboard/lib/score-analytics-utils.ts
Regression test: /code/langfuse/web/src/__tests__/server/score-analytics-utils.servertest.ts

Validation attempted: pnpm --filter web run test score-analytics-utils.servertest.ts. The mounted source snapshot cannot start pnpm because the repository references missing inherited file patches/next-auth@4.24.15.patch (ENOENT), before Vitest runs.

Internal evidence: /knowledge/company/sources/slack/eng-ml/2334567001-multilang-calibration-bin-edge-bug.json and /knowledge/company/sources/confluence/applied-ml-and-evals/eval-harness/ensemble-eval-orchestration-and-weighting-guidelines-2026.json support deterministic raw bin edges and reproducible aggregation semantics.

# Candidate: count-weighted pivot averages

Issue: /code/upstream-issues/langfuse-15208.md (enterprise_452a1a7f3eb80e14cfc4d7a0)

Correctness contract: when displayed metrics include a count aggregation, compute avg_* subtotals and grand totals as sum(group_average * group_count) / sum(group_count). If a complete positive count vector is unavailable, explicitly preserve the historical equal-group average fallback. Sum, count, min, max, and percentile behavior remains unchanged.

Changed code: /code/langfuse/web/src/features/widgets/utils/pivot-table-utils.ts
Regression test: /code/langfuse/web/src/__tests__/server/pivot-table-utils.servertest.ts (unequal 1/9 groups yield 19; no-count fallback yields 15).

Validation attempted: pnpm --filter web run test pivot-table-utils.servertest.ts. The mounted source snapshot cannot start pnpm because the repository references missing inherited file patches/next-auth@4.24.15.patch (ENOENT), before Vitest runs.

Internal evidence: /knowledge/company/sources/github/eval-harness/pr-243190-add-coverage-weighted-eval-harness-and-stable-delta-reporter.json and /knowledge/company/sources/confluence/applied-ml-and-evals/eval-harness/ensemble-eval-orchestration-and-weighting-guidelines-2026.json support coverage/count-weighted aggregation and explicit strategy selection.

arguments.summary: For Langfuse score analytics, histogram bucket membership must be computed from raw numeric values; rounding is presentation-only and label precision must keep adjacent bin edges distinct. Pivot-table avg subtotals and grand totals must be count-weighted when a complete positive count metric is available: sum(group average × group count) / sum(group count). When counts are absent, incomplete, or non-positive, preserve the explicitly tested historical equal-group-average fallback. Non-average aggregations remain unchanged.
